method: Inspected the original target and all 11 finished frames before any source or metrics. Scores are subjective visual judgments for the compact procedural game asset, not exact target parity.
findings: The four corrected timber tie penetrations have not returned. Roof courses stay inside the curved barge/eave envelope, and the roof casts a continuous shadow.
Fish read as stock held in raised trays; no conspicuous stock spilling through the counter walls. The repeated fish arrangement remains simplified.
Canopy scallops form a coherent front hem; post ties and supports remain attached. The two counters preserve the center doorway approach.
Side sign has two visible hangers supported by its arm, and the true side view confirms clearance from the window.
Rear door and its narrow deck approach remain unobstructed. Containers occupy the crane-side strip without cutting through the cottage or pier supports.

market-world-azimuth-0.finding: Bridge joins open front-right deck; sign, canopy and counter do not obstruct the landing. Market stays separated from lighthouse quay.

market-world-azimuth-90.finding: Market is largely occluded by neighboring buildings. This view is not clearance proof; the other three angles cover the relevant contacts.

market-world-azimuth-180.finding: Rear deck/door and side containers clear the lighthouse and adjacent berth; pier and boat separation remains visible.

market-world-azimuth-270.finding: Clear central front lane, connected berth, and both boats outside the pier supports. No new visible neighbor intersections.

remainingTargetGaps: Slate color variation forms regular bands and tiles remain more gridlike than the inferred target.
Timber grain repeats uniformly; stone, canvas and wood have little weathering or local wear.
Fish stock and hanging emblem are simple low-detail forms compared with the target.
scope: Accept the finished fish-market part and evidenced assembly placement for this iteration. This is not exact inferred-target identity or whole-island V2 approval. Runtime and geometry budgets are validated separately by root.
